idea-plugin.name: AI Sessions Dashboard
idea-plugin.description:
See token usage and context size of Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot CLI sessions and their subagents, live, inside your IDE.

A token usage dashboard for AI coding agents (Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI) in the AI Sessions tool window:

  • All providers in one tree, each session marked with its provider icon
  • Every session and subagent, nested to any depth, with its context window size, tokens spent, LLM model, duration and an estimated cost from per-model prices you set
  • Every AI call of a session, with the prompt or trigger that started it
  • Live activity, with sound and blink alerts when an agent asks a question, needs a permission or has finished
  • Local and read-only: a bundled server on localhost reads the agents' session files; no data leaves your machine

Free to use, including at work, under the MIT License with the Commons Clause: selling the software or its modifications is not allowed. Source: github.com/artur-faizov/AI-sessions-dashboard.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
3.2.4

  • Claude Code: time when Claude Code has not written a call to the transcript yet shows as AI time on the chart instead of unknown
  • Version moved from the settings menu to the top-left corner

3.2.3

  • "Context prefix" button next to the "hide shorter than" switch: opens what the first call's context was made of (system prompt, tool and MCP schemas, skills, instructions)
  • The first call stays in the calls list even when it is shorter than the "hide shorter than" limit, so subagents show their context too

3.2.2

  • Context pie shows the exact system prompt and tool schemas for Claude Code and Codex
  • Claude Code: subagents launched by subagents are nested under their launcher
  • Claude Code: a continued session no longer double-counts the history it copied from the original

  • Provider icons before session names
  • Data sources in Settings: per-provider on/off, data path, found or not, edit/Browse/reset
